summary: IEEE VIS 2026 is the premier international conference on visualization and visual analytics, held November 9-13, 2026 in Boston, Massachusetts. The conference covers six research areas and publishes in IEEE TVCG. The event has an established visual identity system with official logos, hex-pattern textures, and Boston-themed imagery.

official_sources.title: IEEE VIS 2026 Official Website
official_sources.notes: Official conference website with dates (Nov 9-13, 2026), location (Boston, MA), venue (Boston Park Plaza Hotel), and registration information. Contains official logos, Boston skyline imagery, and hex-pattern textures.

official_sources.title: IEEE VIS 2026 Call for Participation
official_sources.notes: Details the six research areas: Theoretical & Empirical, Applications, Systems & Rendering, Representations & Interaction, Data Transformations, Analytics & Decisions. Papers published in IEEE TVCG.

official_sources.title: IEEE VIS 2026 Blog - Conference Evolution
official_sources.notes: Discusses conference evolution with focus on big data, AI, and complex systems. Indicates forward-looking, innovation-focused positioning.

official_sources.title: IEEE Brand Identity Guidelines
official_sources.notes: Official IEEE brand guidelines. IEEE master logo must be used according to strict brand standards. The VIS conference logo coexists with the IEEE master brand.

official_sources.title: IEEE VIS 2024 Official Website (Past Identity Reference)
official_sources.notes: Salt Lake City conference with distinct visual identity. Shows how past years created unique logos and merchandise while maintaining IEEE VIS brand continuity.

official_sources.title: IEEE VIS 2025 Official Website (Past Identity Reference)
official_sources.notes: Vienna conference with isotype-based identity system. Demonstrates systematic approach to conference branding across multiple touchpoints.

official_sources.title: The Swiss Grid - Poster House Exhibition
official_sources.notes: Exhibition on International Typographic Style. Provides precedent references for Swiss/International style poster design with geometric composition, bold typography, and grid-based layouts.

official_sources.title: IEEE Visualization Wikipedia Entry
official_sources.notes: Historical context of IEEE VIS conference. Confirms it is the premier visualization conference, co-sponsored by IEEE VGTC.

official_sources.title: IEEE Brand Identity Guidelines
official_sources.notes: Official IEEE brand guidelines. IEEE master logo is a protected trademark with strict usage rules. Conference logos (like VIS) coexist with the master brand. All official materials must include proper IEEE branding.

official_sources.title: The Swiss Grid - Poster House Exhibition
official_sources.notes: Exhibition on International Typographic Style (Swiss Style). Key principles: grid-based composition, bold geometric forms, strong contrast, expressive sans-serif typography, minimal ornamentation. Direct precedent for the IEEE VIS 2026 poster design direction.

existing_brand_assets.description: IEEE VIS 2026 official conference logo (SVG format, auto-converted to PNG). Features stylized 'VIS' typography with geometric elements. Must be preserved and used according to IEEE brand guidelines.
IEEE master brand logo (white version). Protected trademark that must appear on all official materials according to IEEE brand guidelines.
IEEE VGTC (Visualization and Graphics Technical Committee) logo. Co-organizer of VIS conference, logo must be preserved.
Hexagonal pattern texture used throughout the IEEE VIS 2026 website theme. Suggests data visualization aesthetic and could inform design system patterns.
Website uses dark backgrounds (near-black) with accent colors. Color palette appears to include deep blues, teals, and bright accent colors typical of data visualization aesthetics.
Website uses clean sans-serif typography. Conference logo features custom geometric letterforms. Typography should maintain professional, academic tone while allowing for bold, expressive headlines.
Conference positioning: 'the year's premier forum for advances in theory, methods, and applications of visualization and visual analytics'

do_not_duplicate: IEEE VIS 2026 official logo - must use the provided logo, not recreate it
IEEE master brand logo - protected trademark, must use official version
IEEE VGTC logo - protected trademark, must use official version
Exact hex pattern from website - can reference the aesthetic but not copy the exact pattern
Past conference logos (2024, 2025) - each year has its own identity
safe_design_directions: Extend the existing IEEE VIS 2026 identity system across multiple deliverables (poster, social media, badges, PPT)
Use minimalist geometric forms inspired by Swiss/International style
Employ bold, expressive typography for headlines while maintaining readability
Incorporate data visualization aesthetics (hex patterns, network graphs, abstract data forms)
Use Boston-themed imagery and references (skyline, local landmarks) as contextual elements
Create a systematic design language that works across A2 poster, social media sizes, badges, and presentation templates
Use high-contrast color schemes with dark backgrounds and bright accents
Reference the hex-pattern texture as a motif but create original geometric patterns

focus.message_hierarchy: Primary: IEEE VIS 2026 conference name and dates. Secondary: Location (Boston), research areas, registration CTA. Tertiary: Organizers (IEEE, VGTC), venue details.
focus.visual_hook: Combine minimalist geometric composition (Swiss style) with data visualization aesthetics. Use bold typography as the primary visual element, supported by abstract geometric forms that suggest data, networks, or visualization concepts.
focus.typography: Sans-serif typefaces with strong geometric character. Bold, oversized headlines for impact. Clean, readable body text. Consider custom letterforms for 'VIS' that echo the official logo's geometric style.
focus.format_adaptation: Design system must scale from A2 poster (594×420mm) to social media (square, story, banner) to badge (100×70mm) to PPT (16:9). Use modular grid system and consistent spacing/typography scale.
focus.color_strategy: Dark backgrounds (near-black or deep navy) with bright accent colors (teal, cyan, magenta, or orange). High contrast for readability. Reference data visualization color palettes.
focus.motif_development: Hexagonal patterns, network graphs, abstract geometric compositions, data flow visualizations. Can reference the hex-pattern from the website but create original variations.
focus.boston_context: Optional: incorporate subtle Boston references (skyline silhouette, local landmarks) without overwhelming the academic/professional tone.

recommended_anchor_candidates: swiss-style-poster-pkz (precedent for bold typography and contrast)
recommended_conditional_outputs: If Boston context is desired: use boston-skyline-context as reference for subtle skyline integration
If merchandise/application references needed: use ieee-vis-2024-swag as example of identity applied to physical items
If systematic identity approach needed: use ieee-vis-2025-isotypes as example of multi-touchpoint identity system

open_questions: Should the design strictly follow the existing IEEE VIS 2026 color palette from the website, or can we introduce new accent colors while maintaining brand recognition?
Is there a specific conference theme or tagline for 2026 beyond the general positioning statement?
Are there any mandatory elements that must appear on all deliverables (e.g., specific sponsor logos, accessibility requirements)?
What is the primary use context for the A2 poster - will it be displayed at the conference venue, sent to universities, or used for digital promotion?
Should the social media kit include animated/motion graphics versions, or static images only?
